mapper.select:
select count(cc.CaseID) as caseTotal,sum(cc.TotalAmount) as caseAmount from cr_contractbasic ccb right join cr_contractcase cc on ccb.ContractID=cc.ContractID where ccb.MainOrgID = #{orgId} and TotalAmount >0 and cc.LogicDel = 0 and ccb.PropertyModel >= 30
and cc.CreatedDate between #{startTime} and #{endTime}

select count(cc.ContractID) as fulfilTotal from cr_contractbasic cc where cc.MainOrgID = #{orgId} and cc.PropertyModel >=30 and cc.LogicDel = 0
and cc.CreatedDate between #{startTime} and #{endTime}

select count(cc.ContractID) as backdateTotal from cr_contractbasic cc left join cr_contractinfo cci on cc.ContractID=cci.ContractID where cc.MainOrgID = #{orgId} and cc.PropertyModel >=30 and cc.LogicDel = 0 and date_format(cci.PerFormStartDate,'%Y-%c-%d') < date_format(cci.MySignDate,'%Y-%c-%d')
and cc.CreatedDate between #{startTime} and #{endTime}
